threshold_selection.objective: maximum overall Fall F1 on val_id

architecture_selection: higher mean validation Fall F1 over seeds 42,43,44
final_seed_selection: fixed in advance; do not cherry-pick best seed

official_resnet18_training.normalization: pinned official per-record normalization then feature padding

test_policy.prior_test_exposure: original CNN test results were already inspected in earlier work; cannot claim the test set has never been examined

reports: per-device TP FP FN TN and FPR
three-seed mean and sample standard deviation
known_limitations: official train/validation and train/test identical content pairs
small ESP32 validation subset (49 Fall,30 Nonfall)
segment-level evaluation does not measure continuous alarm false positives per hour
threshold tuning does not guarantee acceptable device-level false positives
deployment_claim: research final baseline only; no claim of validated real-world alarm readiness
